"use client" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" import { useMemo, useState } from "react" export type Operation = | "sum" | "average" | "min" | "max" | "count" | "add" | "subtract" | "multiply" | "divide" | "percentage" | "percentage-change" | "remainder" | "power" | "sqrt" | "absolute" | "round" | "floor" | "ceil" | "factorial" | "gcd" | "lcm" export interface CalculationProps extends React.HTMLAttributes { defaultOperation?: Operation defaultInput?: string } const operations: { label: string value: Operation }[] = [ { label: "Sum", value: "sum" }, { label: "Average", value: "average" }, { label: "Minimum", value: "min" }, { label: "Maximum", value: "max" }, { label: "Count", value: "count" }, { label: "Add", value: "add" }, { label: "Subtract", value: "subtract" }, { label: "Multiply", value: "multiply" }, { label: "Divide", value: "divide" }, { label: "Percentage", value: "percentage" }, { label: "Percentage Change", value: "percentage-change" }, { label: "Remainder", value: "remainder" }, { label: "Power", value: "power" }, { label: "Square Root", value: "sqrt" }, { label: "Absolute", value: "absolute" }, { label: "Round", value: "round" }, { label: "Floor", value: "floor" }, { label: "Ceiling", value: "ceil" }, { label: "Factorial", value: "factorial" }, { label: "GCD", value: "gcd" }, { label: "LCM", value: "lcm" }, ] function gcd(a: number, b: number): number { a = Math.abs(a) b = Math.abs(b) while (b) { const temp = b b = a % b a = temp } return a } function factorial(n: number): number { if (n < 0 || !Number.isInteger(n)) return NaN let result = 1 for (let i = 2; i <= n; i++) { result *= i } return result } function calculate(operation: Operation, values: number[]): number { const [a = 0, b = 0] = values switch (operation) { case "sum": return values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) case "average": return values.length ? values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length : 0 case "min": return values.length ? Math.min(...values) : 0 case "max": return values.length ? Math.max(...values) : 0 case "count": return values.length case "add": return a + b case "subtract": return a - b case "multiply": return a * b case "divide": return b === 0 ? NaN : a / b case "percentage": return (a * b) / 100 case "percentage-change": return a === 0 ? NaN : ((b - a) / a) * 100 case "remainder": return b === 0 ? NaN : a % b case "power": return Math.pow(a, b) case "sqrt": return Math.sqrt(a) case "absolute": return Math.abs(a) case "round": return Math.round(a) case "floor": return Math.floor(a) case "ceil": return Math.ceil(a) case "factorial": return factorial(a) case "gcd": return gcd(a, b) case "lcm": return a && b ? Math.abs(a * b) / gcd(a, b) : 0 default: return 0 } } export function Calculation({ defaultOperation = "sum", defaultInput = "100, 200, 300", className, ...props }: CalculationProps) { const [operation, setOperation] = useState(defaultOperation) const [input, setInput] = useState(defaultInput) const values = useMemo( () => input .split(",") .map((value) => Number(value.trim())) .filter((value) => !Number.isNaN(value)), [input] ) const result = calculate(operation, values) const formattedResult = Number.isNaN(result) ? "Invalid calculation" : Number.isFinite(result) ? Number(result.toFixed(6)).toLocaleString() : "Invalid calculation" return (
